title.narrative: Accelerating and Strengthening the quality of Malaria Control interventions in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Mozambique, Malaria, World Vision International (WVI)This program has the following goals: Reduce malaria morbidity at national level by at least 40% compared to levels observed in 2015. Reduce malaria inpatient mortality at national level by at least 40% compared to levels observed in 2015. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen program management skills at central, provincial & district levels, to achieve the Strategic Plan objectives. Provide at least 85% coverage of the population with a minimum of one vector control intervention, in every district of the country. Test 100% of suspected malaria cases & treat 100% of confirmed malaria cases, at health facility & community level, as per national guidelines. Implement an effective SBCC approach to ensure at least 70% of people seek appropriate & timely healthcare and at least 85% of the population uses an appropriate protection method. Strengthen the surveillance system so 100% of health facilities & districts are reporting complete, timely & quality data

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for MOZ-M-WVP03
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection

Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for MOZ-M-WVP03
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Outcome indicators targets and results for MOZ-M-WVP03
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people and/or sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
